variation: Standing light dumbbell Cuban Press: row, external rotation, press, reverse
referenceLimitations: Retrieved technique description corroborates rotation/press segment; seated source does not establish standing setup. Full independent biomechanical approval outstanding.

frames.label: Set up
frames.cue: Stand tall with light dumbbells in front of your thighs.

frames.label: Raise elbows
frames.cue: Lead with your elbows, keeping your wrists below them.

frames.label: Rotate up
frames.cue: Rotate your forearms up while keeping your elbows bent.

frames.label: Lower to goalpost
frames.cue: Lower to the goalpost position under control.

frames.label: Rotate down
frames.cue: Rotate your forearms down, then lower your elbows to return to the start.

loopBoundary: After frame 6 lower elbows and weights to thighs for frame 1. Do not ping-pong.
notes: Shorts v2 supersedes earlier unshorted drafts. Six frame files use four poses; reverse goalpost and row poses reused for exact return registration.
